items.name: Russia–Ukraine peace talks
items.summary: US-brokered diplomacy on ending the war: trilateral talks planned for Abu Dhabi in the first half of November, local ceasefires such as Oleshky, prisoner swaps, and Europe's push for a seat at the table.

items.name: US–Iran war and Hormuz
